name: useMediaLibrary
summary: Saving captures to the gallery, and reading what is there.
plain: Puts a photo or video into the user's own gallery, where it survives and other apps can see it. Without this a capture sits in the app's cache and disappears when the system needs space. Also lists recent items and can delete one.
description: Wraps expo-media-library. SDK 57 uses Asset.create, Album.create, and Query; deprecated saveToLibraryAsync and createAssetAsync throw. save() requests write-only access and does not require read permission unless an album name is supplied. Read and write grants are tracked independently: permissionGranted and hasLimitedAccess describe browsing, not permission to add new media. Asset fields are async accessors flattened into a SavedMedia object; failures surface through error.

returns.name: permissionGranted
returns.desc: Whether browsing the media library is permitted; save() separately requests write-only access.

returns.name: hasLimitedAccess
returns.desc: Android 13+: the user shared only selected items, so the library is not fully visible.

returns.name: isSaving
returns.desc: True while a file is being written.

returns.name: isLoading
returns.desc: True while the library is being read.

returns.name: recent
returns.desc: Newest items from the last loadRecent call, most recent first.

returns.name: lastSaved
returns.desc: The item this app most recently wrote.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Hardware when read or write gallery permission is granted; unavailable otherwise.

actions.name: requestPermission(writeOnly?)
actions.desc: Asks for read access by default, or only write access when writeOnly is true.

inputs.name: writeOnly
inputs.desc: True asks only for write access, for an app that saves but never browses. Defaults to false.

actions.output: Resolves true when granted. A write-only grant does not set permissionGranted or imply browsing rights; hasLimitedAccess describes read access.

actions.name: save(localUri, albumName?)
actions.desc: Copies a local capture into the user media store using SDK 57 Asset.create; requests write-only permission automatically, and read permission only if selecting a named album.

inputs.name: localUri
inputs.desc: The file useCamera or useAudio returned.

inputs.name: albumName
inputs.desc: Album to file it under. Created when it does not exist.

actions.output: Resolves with { id, uri, filename, width, height, durationSeconds, creationTime }, or null when the grant or write fails; error explains the failure. A failed album creation after the asset is saved is reported in error without claiming that the file itself failed to save.

actions.name: loadRecent(limit?)
actions.desc: Reads the newest items in the library, newest first.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.desc: How many items to read. Defaults to 20.

actions.output: Resolves with the items, also written to recent. Empty array when permission was denied.

actions.name: remove(media)
actions.desc: Deletes an item from the device. The system may show its own confirmation.

inputs.name: media
inputs.desc: An item from recent or lastSaved.

actions.output: Resolves true when the item was deleted, and it is dropped from recent.

agentNote: save() requests write-only permission for an unnamed album; reading recent media or selecting an existing named album requires a separate read grant. Never call deprecated saveToLibraryAsync on SDK 57. A capture is not kept until save() succeeds; handle hasLimitedAccess when browsing.
